held.why: Every workflow token reads the repository's metadata without asking, so a recipe never asks for `metadata: read`.

source.says: The job's token read GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} and its visibility under four permission sets, and each answered private: contents: read alone, pull-requests: read alone, id-token: write alone, and no permission at all, with the workflow's permissions: {} and none on the job. So metadata: read is held without asking.
